scheme_name: Goa State Export Market Development Scheme, 2008
other_conditions: Unit must be set up in Goa and permanently registered or acknowledged with Entrepreneurs Memorandum II by the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce
Unit must have been in operation for a minimum period of three years
Unit must possess an import/export code issued by the Reserve Bank of India/Government of India or any competent authority of the Government of India
Total turnover of the unit for the last three preceding financial years must not exceed ₹10,00,00,000
The facility can be availed only once in the unit’s lifetime; transferred or sold units are not eligible if the original unit has already taken benefits
benefits_summary: Interest‑free loan up to ₹5,00,000 for participating in shows/exhibitions or market study tours abroad, repayable over five years in equal half‑yearly installments
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested, if required)
